description: Funding & Grants: opportunity discovery, owner-scoped profiles, eligibility, shortlists, application preparation and monitoring over shared Research, Decision Support, Creation, Awareness and intake providers.

profiles.description: Applicant vocabulary and defaults; applicant facts stay owner-scoped

Development finance: a funder, country, sector or organisation to each publisher's aid activities with version history, transactions, participating organisations, allocations and reported results, OECD CRS aggregates with their vintage and World Bank projects linked by stated identifiers, publishers side by side with their coverage

vocabulary.publisher: the organisation that reports an activity (IATI reporting-org), never merged with another publisher
vocabulary.activity: one IATI activity as one publisher reports it; the same identifier from two publishers is two activities
vocabulary.revision: one version of an activity, in force by the publisher's last-updated-datetime
vocabulary.coverage: what a bounded selection requested and returned per publisher; stale when a refresh failed or stopped early
vocabulary.withdrawn: no longer returned by the publisher's complete selection; never read as ended
vocabulary.vintage: one OECD CRS release of an aggregate cell; earlier vintages stay addressable

workflow_defaults.as_of: revisions and vintages observed on or before the date; each publisher's revision in force is selected before filtering
workflow_defaults.publishers: side by side; no total across publishers; conflicting values shown with both provenance chains
workflow_defaults.currency: reported currency only; conversion only with a cited rate, rate date and source
workflow_defaults.never: Published aid activities and statistics as each publisher reported them: no effectiveness or impact judgement, no total across publishers, no activity inferred from a statistic and no currency conversion without a cited rate and date.
